# Calculator operations

A tiny CommonJS calculator. Each operation is its own module at the repo root.

## P1-M1-1: divide
`divide.js` exports `divide(a, b)` returning `a / b`.

## P1-M1-2: modulo
`modulo.js` exports `modulo(a, b)` returning `a % b`.

## P1-M1-3: power
`power.js` exports `power(a, b)` returning `a ** b`.
